newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank sells dollar-indexed Treasury notes.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank sells dollar-indexed Treasury notes.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank sold 550 million of dollar-indexed National Treasury Notes (NTN-D) paying annual yields of 11.08 percent, dealers said.
Traders said the Central Bank sold the securities to calm the dollar futures markets which have been rattled by speculation over the country's mounting trade deficit.
Speculation that Brazil will post a trade gap of between $1.3 billion and $1.5 billion in December has made forex trade volatile. Official figures are not expected out till next week.
The NTN-Ds have a maturity period of 24 months and are due in July 1, 1997. The securities were part of Central Bank's portfolio.
